$comment: The few sentences of llms.txt and the markdown copies that are not on the pages themselves: what a machine needs said once and plainly (docs/site-audit/03-ax.md, appendix). Everything else in those files comes from apps/web/app/_site/copy.ts at build time (scripts/site/llms.mjs). Checked against docs/status.md and alyr-design/honesty.md on 24 Oct 2026. No prices outside the pricing page's own copy (pricing.md, ar/pricing.md), no AI words: scripts/site/banned-words.mjs checks these files too. The site lane may move these words into copy.ts later.

contact.whatsapp: Message us on WhatsApp: {link}. A person from ALYR replies.
contact.email: Email us: {email}. A person from ALYR replies.
contact.pending: Contact details are not published yet.

llms.money: ALYR never holds a shop's money. Payment links are built and tested on a test page; card payments are not live yet. Once a shop's own payment provider is connected, payments go to the shop's own account.
llms.pricesOff: Prices are on the pricing page, {pricing}: each month by bank transfer in Qatari riyals or by card in US dollars, month to month, with no setup fee.
llms.pricesOn: Prices are on the pricing page, {pricing}, and in the homepage's Price section.
llms.new: ALYR is new and is choosing its first businesses in Doha now. ALYR sets up every product with each business, at its shop.
llms.samples: The screens and numbers drawn on alyr.qa are samples from fictional businesses ({shops}). They are not ALYR's results, and these are not customers.
llms.markdown: Each page has a markdown copy at the same address with .md (the homepage at /index.md, the Arabic homepage at /ar.md). llms-full.txt holds them all.
llms.homeLine: what ALYR does, how it works, owners' questions

caveats.bookings: Today it takes one booking at a time for the whole business.
caveats.agent: Its suggestions come from counts and comparisons of the shop's own records; the owner decides. A weekly report on WhatsApp starts once WhatsApp approves its wording.

llms.noApp: Customers order and book on a page that opens from the WhatsApp chat, with no app, no account and no password.
